# Controlled Wilson quarter evolution is not generated by the frozen architecture

Owner: `marici.Kitaev`

Ledger: Entry 2468  
Graph: `ev-000000003382-4f0fb0c4-30b9-4a4c-8a2c-b61e4577f1f6`

## Bounded question

Does the frozen microscopic and fault-tolerant $D(S_3)$ architecture execute
the controlled gates

\[
  \operatorname{ctrl}\!\left(e^{2\pi iW_x/4}\right)
\]

needed by the exact mod-four phase-kickback compiler?

## Exact logical obstruction

Use the frozen $A,\ldots,H\leftrightarrow000,\ldots,111$ sector encoding.
For every Wilson type occurring in a minimum faithful family,

\[
  x\in\{C,D,E,F,G,H\},
\]

the checker constructs $e^{2\pi iW_x/4}$ from the exact modular character
table and tests its conjugation action on every Pauli generator. None is a
three-qubit Clifford operation. Adding one binary control does not help: none
of the six controlled gates normalizes the four-qubit Pauli group either.

Every one of the eight minimum faithful families consists of four members of
this non-Clifford set. The frozen executable architecture—encoded stabilizer
states, Clifford gates, Pauli measurements, and Pauli feed-forward—therefore
cannot generate any required family. The phase-kickback construction is a
correct conditional compiler, but it relocates the missing nonstabilizer
resource into controlled Wilson evolution.

## Microscopic constructor audit

A closed anyon ribbon is not the required gate. Pair creation, transport
around the cycle, and annihilation produces a Wilson/monodromy amplitude;
because the character eigenvalues include $0,\pm1,\pm3$, this insertion is
generally nonunitary and is not exponentiation of the Hermitian Wilson
operator. Turning it into the target exponential requires Hamiltonian
simulation, block encoding/LCU with coherent selection, or an equivalent
nonstabilizer gadget. None is frozen as a source operation.

The available geometric constructors have the familiar locality tradeoff:

- A mobile ancilla makes $L$ sequential contacts along a noncontractible
  cycle. A persistent ancilla fault can spread through a suffix of $O(L)$
  contacts and produce logical damage, so the bare constructor is not
  one-fault tolerant.
- A verified distributed ancilla reduces data-contact depth to one and makes
  each transversal contact fault affect at most one data site. Its length-
  $L$ nonstabilizer state must itself be prepared and verified, which is the
  missing factory rather than a derived resource.
- A single localized controller cannot distribute its control to all
  length-$L$ loop contacts through bounded-range gates in sublinear depth.
  Parallel depth one is possible only after charging a pre-shared distributed
  control resource and its preparation/verification.

Ideal compute--phase--uncompute leaves no final label leakage. A lost or
retained pointer instead records the sector and dephases cross-sector matrix
elements. Distance three becomes sufficient only conditionally if each
missing controlled-Wilson module is first supplied as a one-fault-tolerant
extended rectangle; it is not an executable distance claim for the present
source theory.

## Shared constructor verdict

The four gates share an abstract circuit skeleton and modulus-four pointer,
but not an admitted physical constructor. Selecting $x$, coherently
realizing its ribbon algebra, and supplying its non-Clifford quarter phase are
precisely the missing operations. Calling this a single parameterized
constructor would therefore assume the conclusion.

There is nevertheless an exact interconversion result. Exhausting all 1,344
three-bit affine permutations and all diagonal Clifford phase corrections
splits the six quarter evolutions into two magic species:

\[
  \{C,F,G,H\},\qquad \{D,E\}.
\]

Every minimum faithful family contains members of both species. Thus affine
and diagonal-Clifford interconversion can reduce four label-specific factories
to two species factories, but cannot reduce them to one. A truly universal
single constructor would require an additional non-Clifford selector and is
not present in the frozen source.

## Falsifiers

The no-go is falsified by an already admitted frozen operation that fails the
stabilizer description, a Pauli-normalizer certificate for one complete
faithful family, or a verified source-derived controlled-Wilson exRec with
bounded fault spread. Any such evidence would trigger a constructive factory
and malignant-pair audit.
